name: Sietel Limited
summary: Sietel Limited invests in industrial, commercial, and retail real estate properties in Australia. It also finances and leases facilities, as well as offers plant and management services. In addition, the company also operates as a commercial vehicle body builder; and a designer, developer, importer, and distributor of domestic appliances, as well as a property maintenance company. Sietel Limited is based in Moorabbin, Australia.
